goal: Add 200 new authentic Bahraini dishes (pan_bahraini / gulf_shared) to the food database, emphasizing Bahraini staples: Machboos, Muhammar, Balaleet, Harees, Thareed, Halwa Showaiter.

pan_bahraini: Signature Bahraini dishes (Machboos, Muhammar, Balaleet, Harees, Thareed, Daqoos, Halwa Showaiter, Muharraq breads, Khalifa Street grills)
gulf_shared: Gulf-wide dishes with a Bahraini preparation (biryanis, kabsa, samboosa, shawarma, shared sweets and drinks)

meal_types.breakfast: Balaleet, foul, regag, khameer, harees, date breakfasts
meal_types.lunch: Machboos and fish variants, rice platters, main dishes, grilled items
meal_types.snacks: Bahraini sweets, halwa, sharbat, dairy, salads and dips
